tagline: Reimagining energy for people and our planet
hero_kpi_rationale: Hydrocarbon production is the master KPI in the upstream sector and BP's primary revenue driver. No distinct wow factor identified.

kpis.name: Hydrocarbon Production
kpis.explanation: Barrels of oil equivalent produced per day by BP, including oil, gas, and natural gas liquids.
kpis.description: BP increased production in 2025 driven by ongoing projects in Guyana and Azerbaijan. Q1 2026 production remains stable around 1.1 Mboe/d.
kpis.signal: Moderate production growth despite the energy transition.

kpis.name: Refining Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between the selling price of refined products and the cost of crude oil, key to downstream profitability.
kpis.description: Refining margin stabilized in 2025 despite oil price volatility. Q1 2026 refining availability was 96.3%.
kpis.signal: Margin improvement due to strong diesel demand and refinery optimization.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated after necessary investments, used for dividends and share buybacks.
kpis.description: FCF increased in 2025, supported by strong operations and cost reductions. Q1 2026: Operating cash flow $2.9 billion (before working capital build).
kpis.signal: Rising FCF driven by improved operational discipline and asset divestitures.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted EBITDA divided by revenue, reflecting operational profitability.
kpis.description: Adjusted margin improved in 2025, driven by refining and marketing activities.
kpis.signal: Margin expansion due to cost optimization and stronger downstream performance.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Annual spending to develop production and maintain infrastructure.
kpis.description: BP reduced its capex in 2025 while maintaining key strategic projects. Q1 2026 Capex: $3.3 billion (annualized ~$13.2 billion).
kpis.signal: Capex reduction to strengthen financial discipline and redirect capital toward cash return.

kpis.name: Proved Reserves Life
kpis.explanation: Number of years BP can produce at current rates with existing proved reserves.
kpis.description: Despite the energy transition, BP maintains an R/P ratio of 8 years through targeted discoveries and acquisitions.
kpis.signal: Reserves life remains stable, reflecting balanced management between production and reserve replacement.

kpis.name: Renewables and Low-Carbon Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Annual investments in renewable energy and low-carbon technologies.
kpis.description: In 2025, BP announced a strategic refocusing with a 50% reduction in capex allocated to renewables. This cut reflects the revised strategy emphasizing traditional energy and a more gradual transition.
kpis.signal: BP significantly reduces low-carbon capex following the 2025 strategic refocusing.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies is present in the provided BP 20-F/6-K filing.
